name: Shekhar Social Connect
author: Shashank Shekhar

sections.description:
Shekhar Social Connect is a powerful WhatsApp chat and live support plugin that helps you connect with your website visitors instantly using a modern floating chat button.

Increase conversions, improve customer engagement, and provide instant support with smart automation — no coding required.

Perfect for businesses, agencies, WooCommerce stores, and service providers who want to turn visitors into customers.

🚀 Key Features

✔ Floating WhatsApp chat button
✔ Smart business hours (auto online/offline)
✔ Pre-filled auto messages
✔ Fully customizable design
✔ WooCommerce support
✔ Lightweight & fast

💬 Floating Chat Button

Add a beautiful floating chat button to your website.

Customize:

• Button position (Bottom Right, Bottom Left, Middle Right, Middle Left)
• Button layout (Bubble, Rectangle, Rounded)
• Custom CTA text
• Button animations (Pulse, Bounce, Shake, Zoom)
• Notification bubble
• Custom icon upload

⏰ Smart Business Hours

Control when your chat is available.

Features:

• Timezone selection
• Working days setup
• Auto offline message
• Smart availability indicator
• Token-based auto messages

Automatically respond to users even when you’re offline.

⚡ Auto Messages with Dynamic Tokens

Send personalized messages automatically.

Supported variables:

{SITE_TITLE} → Website title
{SITE_URL} → Website URL
{CURRENT_TITLE} → Page title
{CURRENT_URL} → Page URL

Improve engagement with smart personalization.

🎨 Customization & Branding

Match your brand perfectly:

• Custom button colors
• Header colors
• FAQ hover color
• Font family & size
• Profile avatar
• Clean modern UI

📊 Basic Analytics (Free)

Track user engagement:

• Chat button clicks
• Interaction overview

More advanced analytics coming soon.

🛒 WooCommerce Ready

Works seamlessly with WooCommerce.

Display chat button on:

• Entire website
• Specific pages
• Product pages (Premium – Coming Soon)

Help customers ask questions before buying.

🔮 Premium Features (Coming Soon)

• White Label Mode
• Multi-Agent Support
• Product Page Chat Buttons
• Trigger Options (Delay, Scroll, Exit Intent)
• Google Analytics (GA4) Integration
• Advanced Targeting
• Multi-Channel Support
• CRM / Webhook Integration

🔐 GDPR Friendly

No personal data is stored.

All conversations happen in external messaging apps.

Support

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search “Shekhar Social Connect”
  3. Install and activate
  4. Configure settings from dashboard
sections.faq:
Can I use my own chat number?

Yes, you can use any supported messaging number.

Can I customize the design?

Yes, full control over colors, layout, and animations.

Can I set business hours?

Yes, define working days and automate responses.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, fully optimized for mobile devices.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes, with more advanced features coming soon.
